Res-3.title: Get Pre-Authorized Debit Agreement Response Payload

accepted.description:
Whether the PAD was accepted or not:
  * `0` - Unaccepted
  * `1` - Accepted

If the PAD is set to accepted and the PAD is active, a side effect of updating the associated bank account to ready will also happen. If the PAD was set to unaccepted, it will unready the bank account.

type.description:
The type of the bank account:
  * `1` - Personal
  * `2` - Business

status.description:
The status of the PAD:
  * `1` - Active
  * `2` - Inactive

If the PAD is set to active and the PAD is accepted, a side effect of updating the associated bank account to ready will also happen. If the PAD was unaccepted, it will unready the bank account. Note: there can only be 1 active PAD per bank account.

type.description: The invoice type. Allowed values: ESTIMATE, QUOTE, ORDER, PURCHASE_ORDER, INVOICE, STATEMENT, REGISTRATION, CREDIT. Defaults to `INVOICE` if omitted.

status.description: The initial status of the invoice. Allowed values: CANCELLED, DUE, PAID, SHIPPED, COMPLETED, REFUNDED, IN_PROGRESS. Defaults to `DUE` if omitted.

convenienceFeeEnabled.description: Indicates whether a convenience fee is enabled for this invoice. If not provided, the system will use the merchant's global Fee Saver settings to determine this value.

tipAmount.description: Optional tip amount to include. Must be greater than zero if provided.

invoiceNumber.description: Optional custom invoice number.  If omitted or blank, the system will generate one automatically based on the Invoice Settings.

notes.description: Optional notes to display at the bottom of the invoice, visible to the customer.

bankAccountId.description: The bank account ID to withdraw from.

customerId.description: The customer ID associated with the bank account.

orderId.description: An optional invoice ID to process the withdrawal with. If provided, the withdrawal action will perform invoice and inventory management.

currencyId.description:
The currency of the transaction:
  * `1` - CAD
  * `2` - USD

example.message: Successfully refunded transaction ID #1342. Refund transaction ID #1355 created.
Successfully voided transaction ID #24732. Void transaction ID #24859 created.

batchId.description: The id for the ACH batch.

batchReference.description: The reference identifier for the ACH batch.

merchantId.description: The id of the merchant associated with this batch.

statusBatch.description: The current state of the batch. Valid values: 1 (Open), 2 (Closed).

dateOpened.description: The timestamp indicating when the batch was opened.

dateClosed.description: The timestamp indicating when the batch was closed.

currency.description: Currency of terminal. possible values are CAD | USD

status.description: Status of Terminal. possible values are ACTIVE | INACTIVE

dateCreated.description: Date and time when the device was created in the format "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"

currency.description: The currency code for the transaction amount, such as CAD or USD.

transactionAmount.description: The amount to be processed, specified in the currency defined by the currency parameter.

invoiceNumber.description:
An identifier for an invoice.
If an existing invoiceNumber is provided, Helcim will relate this transaction to that invoice.
If invoiceNumber provided does not exist, Helcim will create an invoice and link the provided invoiceNumber.
If not provided, Helcim will create an invoice.

customerCode.description:
An identifier for a customer.
If existing customerCode is provided, Helcim will attach that customer.
If customerCode provided does not exist, Helcim will create a customer with the provided customerCode.
If not provided, Helcim will create a customer.

transactionAmount.description: The amount to be refunded in the currency on the original transaction.

originalTransactionId.description:
The identifier of the original transaction to refund.
This identifier must correspond to the transaction Id of the original transaction to be refunded.
